main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean next-day excess return on bars with forecast > 0
main_measure.threshold: confirm: positive with t >= 2 and Spearman > 0; reject: negative with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: Spearman(forecast, next-day excess return) on forecast > 0 bars > 0

decided_by: The weighted mean excess return is positive with t >= 2 and the Spearman correlation is above 0.
reading: The t of the forecast-weighted mean uses the weighted standard error sqrt(sum(w^2 (x-m)^2) / (sum w)^2 * n/(n-1)), every in-window bar with a next bar counts as a case, the coin's mean daily return is over all its in-window daily returns, and the plan's 200-bar minimum yields 'not observable' when unmet.
